name: Mistral
description: Mistral account budget, live model catalog, per-call cost ledger, OCR, embeddings and fill-in-the-middle, plus MISTRAL_API_KEY injection for the agents Orca launches.

cover.alt: The Mistral panel showing a Vibe budget bar, API budget bar and today's estimated spend

settings.title: API endpoint
settings.description: Mistral API base URL. Change it only for a proxy or a compatible gateway.

settings.title: API key environment variable
settings.description: Read when no key is stored in Orca's secrets.

settings.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often the worker refreshes the budget and the status bar.

settings.title: Show today's spend in the status bar
Inject MISTRAL_API_KEY into launched agents
settings.description: Adds the stored key to the environment of agents Orca launches, so their Mistral provider works without a shell export.

settings.title: Agents that receive the key
settings.description: Comma-separated agent ids, such as pi,dsh,hermes,opencode. Empty injects into every agent.

settings.title: Extra arguments per agent
settings.description: JSON object mapping an agent id to CLI arguments appended at launch, such as {"pi":"--model mistral-responses/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017"}.

settings.title: Price overrides
settings.description: JSON object keyed by model id, with input, output, cacheRead, per1000Pages, per1000AnnotatedPages, perMinute or perMillionChars in USD.
